title: Cold boot admits a well-formed tail row of an unknown Message variant that the eager loader would quarantine
outcome: A finished delegation child whose retained tail holds a well-formed row that does not decode as a Message (for example a variant written by a newer build) is handled deliberately: either quarantined at boot as the eager loader does, or served with an explicit, visible per-row error, and the chosen behaviour is documented and tested.
acceptance: Cold boot admits a well-formed tail row of an unknown Message variant that the eager loader would quarantine is done
